scope: Fresh authored development fixtures, not an independent accuracy benchmark. No real police footage or trained-model predictions are embedded.

clips.title: Official online payment
lines: The fine is thirty dollars. Please pay the fine online and keep your official receipt.
Thank you. I will use the official payment website.

clips.title: Personal cash and waived ticket
lines: Pay me cash and I will make the ticket disappear. Keep this off the record.
I want to follow the official process. Please explain that request.

clips.title: Counter payment with receipt
lines: The published fee is fifteen dollars. Please pay at the counter.
The cashier will give you an official receipt for the exact amount.

clips.title: Direct payment without receipt
lines: You can pay me directly. No receipt is needed.
Why would I pay you instead of the cashier? Please explain.

clips.title: Explicit refusal
lines: I will never accept a bribe. Do not offer a bribe.
I understand. Please give me the official receipt and payment instructions.

clips.title: Conditional payment demand
lines: Give me money or I will hold your permit until tomorrow.
Please explain the published fee. I would like this request reviewed.

clips.title: Reported allegation
lines: He said pay me cash, so I am reporting what happened earlier.
We will record your account. We have not established what the original speaker intended.

clips.title: Emergency assistance request
lines: Officer down. Send an ambulance. We need medical assistance now.
I am checking the location and following the emergency procedure.

clips.title: Ordinary cash purchase
lines: I paid cash at the grocery shop this morning and collected my receipt.
Thank you for explaining. Please keep the documents for your records.

clips.title: Indirect personal benefit
lines: Maybe you could do something for me, and we can forget about the ticket.
What do you mean by that? Please explain the official procedure.
